label: Recovering after an increase
subgoals: Write an increase of p percent as the multiplier 1 + p/100.
Divide the new amount by the multiplier.
Check that the recovered amount is smaller than the new amount.

label: Recovering after a decrease
subgoals: Write a decrease of p percent as the multiplier 1 - p/100.
Divide the new amount by the multiplier.
Check that the recovered amount is larger than the new amount.

label: Checking the result
subgoals: Apply the original percent change to the recovered amount.
Compare the result with the stated new amount.
Identify the error when the percentage was applied to the new amount.
